verdict.line: You lose if you let Granite Shield sit fully charged and trade into it for free; you win if you force an all-in while his shield is down, since the matchup runs 51.3% over 2842 games in your favor.

brief.thesis: Malphite's Granite Shield only recharges if he hasn't been hit recently, so passive poke trades just feed him free mitigation. Your kit breaks that: Death's Grasp (E) drags him into range, Obliterate (Q) deals bonus damage to a single target, and Darkness Rise procs off spells as well as autos, so you can build full trade pressure without ever relying on an auto-attack he can punish with Ground Slam's attack-speed cut.

theirWindow.when: shield fully recharged, no recent damage on him
theirWindow.what: Don't commit Q/E into him here — he eats the first hit for free and answers with Seismic Shard (Q) to strip your move speed and kite. Hold your cooldowns and wait for the shield to crack.

yourWindow.when: right after he fires Q or E to poke you
yourWindow.what: His Ground Slam (7s cd) and Seismic Shard (8s cd) are both down and his shield hasn't rebuilt. Step in with E to pull him, land Q for the single-target bonus, and lean on spell damage over autos since his E punishes attack speed specifically.

powerCurve.note: Granite Shield blunts your early poke for free
E online, trades even out once shield cracks
R removes him from fights, snowball starts
Rylai's magic damage outscales his armor tank stats

start.why: Sustain through his Seismic Shard poke while you wait out Granite Shield resets; the 52.6% winrate line over Doran's Shield reflects that you're the one forcing extended trades, not absorbing his.

boots.why: Tenacity cuts the movement-speed steal from Seismic Shard and the magic resist blunts his Ground Slam poke damage, which scales off his armor stacking.

core.why: The slow locks him down so he can't kite the Seismic Shard steal you're fighting around, and it's the first item in the highest-winrate path (57.5% over 435 games).
Omnivamp sustains you through his poke phase and the empowered damage after 3s in combat rewards the extended trades Rylai's lets you force.
Stacking burn punishes his tank stats directly and closes out the build that hits 57.5% winrate in this exact order.

situational.when: you need more healing and magic resist against his ability damage
their team leans attack damage and you need grievous wounds to shut down lifesteal
you want faster Realm of Death uptime to keep removing him from fights

runes.keystoneWhy: Melee skirmishes with Malphite run long once his shield is down, and Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage rewards exactly that kind of extended trade rather than a burst window he doesn't give you.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 68.6% of games at 53.1% winrate, which matches the measured solo-kill advantage here — Ignite closes out all-ins once his shield is cracked and his sustain can't out-race the burn.

playing.title: Weave spells, not autos
playing.detail: Malphite's Ground Slam cuts your attack speed, but Darkness Rise procs off spells as well as autos. Fight with Q and E on cooldown instead of auto-attacking into his E.

playing.title: Save E for the pull-in
playing.detail: Death's Grasp pulls all enemies in its area — use it to yank him off a recharged shield position and into your Q range rather than firing it on cooldown.

playing.title: Land Q on him alone
playing.detail: Obliterate's damage is increased when it hits a single enemy, so in a 1v1 trade angle it to clip only Malphite, not the minion wave.

playing.title: Chip his shield before the real engage
playing.detail: Granite Shield only recharges if he hasn't been hit recently. A stray auto or minion trade keeps it cracked so your actual all-in doesn't get eaten for free.

playing.title: Pop W mid-trade, not after
playing.detail: Indestructible banks damage dealt and taken into a shield you consume to heal — pop it while the exchange is still live to win extended trades, not as cleanup after.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Unstoppable Force
playing.detail: Once he's 6, his knock-up closes 1000 range and resets the fight on his terms. Don't overextend past the wave without Flash up until you can answer it.

playing.title: Use R to delete him from the fight
playing.detail: Realm of Death removes Malphite from the lane or teamfight entirely — save it to win a 2v2 or to take him out of position before his ult lands, not just as a kill tool.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all winrate/sample numbers above are measured from current-patch games on OP.GG; the trade timing, shield-state reads, and ability sequencing are my own tactical read, not sourced stats.

stats.opponentTip: Malphite’s (E) reduces your attack speed, placing you at a disadvantage. Keep this in mind when using your abilities off cooldown to gain lane control.
